hosted_compact.status: monitored experimental attempt; complete linking capacity is not yet established
hosted_compact.basis: Measured inputs ~2.0 GiB and object phase ~1.07 GiB; reserve also covers container/bootstrap, final source archive and still-unmeasured DWARF ELF temporaries. Abort if actual reserve runs low.

conservative.status: conservative workspace margin; not a measured minimum of Full LTO

explanation: The old 45 GiB gate was a conservative policy, not a measured disk requirement. This profile is an instrumented attempt, not a claim that the standard runner suffices.
